fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest (JP3122400009) Aletheia Capital set target price of JPY 51,000 (October 25), current stock price JPY 33,860 (October 27).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q1 revenue JPY 36.747 billion (39.30% year-over-year increase), operating profit JPY 18.999 billion (53.30% increase), with Q2 earnings (October 28) being key to judging sustainability of growth rate.
fields.summary_ko.2: Analyst and investor day scheduled for November 12, with investor focus on whether Q2 revenue and operating profit can continue Q1 growth rate.
